versions.changelog: v1.2.0 adds an explicit, privacy-preserving feedback handoff: a redacted result report can be prepared for the maintainer, but nothing is sent automatically.
v1.1.0: measure and slim per-host always-loaded agent instructions; add two-level project routers, operations guidance, and hardened verification.
Agent-neutral project mapping explanation, simple adoption and ProSkills primary homepage.
Initial MIT release: project context maps, separate GitHub prompt and ClawHub guidance, host-aware adoption and documented security boundaries.
